model.goal: Traceability tree — exactly TWO top-level nodes: 'CurrentSprint: Sprint <N>' with 3 EAGER children (Current / Last Completed / Next Backlog) + a 'Sprints 01-<N>' collection (collapsed, count badge). Structure-eager / payload-lazy: sprint nodes eager, their TASKS load only when the sprint is expanded — so the tree scales as sprints grow (same eager-structure/lazy-payload pattern as R26 federation).
